{
  "dataset_name": "pricerunner",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "vendor_id_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Min-max scaled vendor identifier to normalize the feature for linear SVM margin optimization.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents the vendor identifier from dominating the SVM loss function due to its larger scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(vendor_id - 1.0) / 367.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "cluster_id_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Min-max scaled cluster identifier to provide a normalized continuous feature.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ensures the cluster identifier is on a similar scale to other features, improving convergence for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(cluster_id - 1.0) / 47524.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "vendor_cluster_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplicative interaction between the scaled vendor and cluster identifiers.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures non-linear relationships between vendor and cluster in a format suitable for linear projections.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((vendor_id - 1.0) / 367.0) * ((cluster_id - 1.0) / 47524.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vendor_id_squared",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Squared normalized vendor identifier to emphasize higher vendor values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "polynomial",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a polynomial transformation that allows the linear SVM to approximate non-linear vendor effects.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(vendor_id / 368.0) ** 2"
    },
    {
      "name": "cluster_id_sqrt",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Square root of the cluster identifier, normalized by its maximum approximate square root.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses the long tail of cluster identifiers, creating a smoother distribution for the linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(cluster_id) / 218.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "vendor_cluster_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of vendor identifier to cluster identifier.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 368.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Exposes the relative magnitude of vendor to cluster, which may correlate with specific product groupings.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "vendor_id / cluster_id"
    },
    {
      "name": "appliance_semantic_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A continuous score representing the semantic similarity of the product title to household appliances like washing machines, fridges, and microwaves.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_embedding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous severity measure of appliance-related content, acting as a soft one-hot encoding for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "electronics_semantic_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A continuous score representing the semantic similarity of the product title to consumer electronics like mobile phones, CPUs, digital cameras, and TVs.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_embedding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a continuous projection of electronics-related content, helping the linear SVM separate electronics from appliances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "technical_spec_density",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "The proportion of tokens in the product title that represent technical specifications such as weights, storage capacities, or processor speeds.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "text_statistics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Offers a continuous measure of technical detail, which is highly discriminative for complex electronics versus simpler goods.",
